probes.reading: Use the start date of the first flagged dermatologic event (AOCC01FL = 'Y', CQ01NAM = 'DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS', SAFFL = 'Y') whenever one exists, without the strict 'after TRTSDT' test, as Pilot 6 adtte.r lines 44-54 (event_source with date = ASTDT) and lines 90-97 (derive_param_tte) compute it; an event that starts on TRTSDT therefore counts as the event date. interpretations: Select the published AOCC01FL occurrence first, then test its ASTDT against TRTSDT; do not remove same-day selected events before selecting a later occurrence.

The ADT comment says after TRTSDT, while the upstream treatment-emergent flag definition includes ASTDT equal to TRTSDT. The literal date rule keeps the strict boundary; neither the flag definition nor the SAP treatment-emergent wording silently changes it.
The SAP separately describes worsening and recurrence and its table notes say on or after; the local probe reads published upstream analysis flags rather than rebuilding those flags.
The retained guide explicitly identifies AOCC01FL as the upstream link; its derivation is outside this local ADT probe.
The source date and treatment-emergent flag are read from published ADAE. The retained imputation descriptions govern those upstream values and are not reimplemented inside this ADT rule.
